grouping: a table and its hidden-name twin are one group: their decisions never sit in two splits
states: written by production's own capture into a scratch ledger: ledger/capture.py solution_saved (the proposal kept) for the modifiers, cleaning (with the raw profile) for each step kept

rules.data.cleaning_keep: draft.clean.clean: every step applied is kept (rule:clean)

layout: each split table gets 0 to 5 plain columns drawn apart from its truth (with_plain_columns): benchgen v2 always draws three features, so a column count named the entity

left_out.modifier.groups: tables with both a row time and an entity: the entity recurs over the period, where the product's rule asks the person whether the model will face new ones; the data holds no truth

truths.data.cleaning_keep: decisions_gen.keep_truth: the step the column was planted to need (numbers after missing markers too)

rule: Invented tables with planted truths, seeds never drawn for generated_v2, so a student trained there meets them first here. Labels are true by construction; scores say how a model reads these traps, not real tables. The sealed partition is read once, by the gate, and never used for tuning.
